summary: Lookout Butte's 1962 R-6 cab on the Nez Perce National Forest replaced two earlier structures and is now a Forest Service recreation rental.

access.note: Available through the Forest Service recreation rental program; book before visiting.

visit.trail_note: Reached via roads serving the Moose Creek Ranger District.

events.note: A cab was added to the 1923 pole tower.
50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab built.
Current 15x15 R-6 flat-top cab with catwalk built on a 55-foot timber tower.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register, April 6, 2009.
Available for rental through the Forest Service recreation program.

evidence.quote: A 45' pole tower served as the first Lookout Butte Lookout on the Nez Perce National Forest in 1923 with a cab added in 1925.
A 50' pole tower with L-4 cab was built in 1935 and replaced with the current 15'x15' R-6 flat top cab with catwalk on a 55' timber tower in 1962.
We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: NHLR registration and current rental status

corrections.proposed: ~16.8 m (55 ft tower per NHLR; firelookout.com gives 53 ft)
corrections.why: Sources give slightly different tower heights (55 ft vs 53 ft); recorded height should note this range or pick NHLR as primary.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR states a 55-foot timber tower; firelookout.com states 53 feet. Likely rounding or measurement-point differences; both describe the same 1962 R-6 structure.

notes_for_editor: Staffing history is undocumented across all consulted sources; story omits a staffing section rather than guessing. Minor height discrepancy (55 ft vs 53 ft) noted but not resolved — no source explains it.
